setup_notes.title: Product Spec v2.3
setup_notes.content: The maximum file upload size is 50 MB. Supported formats are PDF, DOCX, and PNG. Rate limit: 100 uploads per user per day.

setup_notes.title: Sprint 12 Kickoff
setup_notes.content: Sprint 12 starts on 1 April 2024. Goal: complete OAuth2 integration. Team velocity estimate: 42 story points.

setup_notes.title: Sprint 12 Retrospective
setup_notes.content: Sprint 12 ended 15 April 2024. Actual velocity: 38 story points. OAuth2 integration was completed successfully. Action item: write OAuth2 documentation by 22 April 2024.

setup_notes.title: Customer Complaint Log Jan 2024
setup_notes.content: Customer ID C-4412 reported slow checkout on 5 Jan 2024. Ticket escalated to backend team.

setup_notes.title: Resolution Log Jan 2024
setup_notes.content: Ticket for customer C-4412 resolved on 12 Jan 2024. Root cause: over-fetching query in checkout pipeline. Fix deployed in release v1.8.3.

setup_notes.content: Password minimum length: 8 characters. Must include at least one uppercase letter.
